common.name: Room lights
common.description: The lights of one room, each with its own brightness control, and the room's scenes
common.empty: Choose an area, lights or scenes in the card's settings.
common.invalid_configuration: Invalid configuration. Lights and scenes must be lists.
common.invalid_height: Invalid height. height and max_height must be positive numbers of pixels, and height_mode auto, fixed or max.

editor.area_helper: Gives the card its name and icon.
editor.fill_helper: Replaces the card's lights and scenes with the chosen area's. Without an area, the card's contents are replaced with the scenes that change the lights of several areas.
editor.name: Name
editor.lights_helper: Dimmable lights are bars, other lights and switches are buttons. A Zigbee light group is shown as one light.
editor.light_name_helper: Leave it empty to use the device's name
editor.scenes_helper: A scene that changes only one of the card's lights is shown on the same row as that light. Other scenes are buttons at the bottom of the card, with the scripts.
editor.adaptive_lighting_helper: Shown in the header, turns adaptive lighting on and off.
editor.turn_on_helper: Which lights the button turns on. When any light is on, the button turns the room's lights off.
editor.height_mode_helper: A height set in the layout tab of a sections view is used instead.
editor.height_helper: The card is always this tall, and the lights and scenes scroll inside it.
editor.max_height_helper: The card grows with its content up to this height, and then the lights and scenes scroll.
